g.text: BrewLite A2 — Order state machine (8 valid transitions) and Payment lifecycle
Payment lifecycle (PaymentStatus)
PENDING
SUCCESS
FAILED
PENDING
PAID
PAYMENT_FAILED
PREPARING
READY
COMPLETED
CANCELLED
New orders set inventoryTracked=true, reserve tracked ingredients
and save an immutable aggregate OrderIngredient snapshot atomically.
Demand sums base + topping quantities across ALL cart lines.
reserved += snapshot; onHand unchanged.
Order stays PENDING while it waits for VNPay: Payment PENDING
(15 min), and past expiry until QueryDR concludes or the
15-min grace after expiresAt ends (E11).
Failure keeps onHand / reserved and snapshot.
Cancel is blocked (409 PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS) while a Payment
PENDING is still valid, or past expiry but not yet reconciled
(past the grace a Payment is closed FAILED first, except
04/05/06/07/09 and MISMATCH).
With inventoryTracked=true, first confirmed success (IPN or QueryDR)
consumes the saved snapshot: onHand -= quantity; reserved -= quantity.
Lock snapshot ingredients by ID; never re-read current recipes.
With inventoryTracked=false, no inventory balance changes on payment.
Replay returns cached SUCCESS;
repeated IPN gets 02; no further consumption.
PAID -> CANCELLED is NOT allowed in A2.
FR-26 is Won't; reject with
409 INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION.
Owner unpaid cancellation with inventoryTracked=true releases once:
reserved -= saved snapshot; onHand unchanged; repeated cancel rejected.
Legacy inventoryTracked=false restores original Product.stock instead.
A Payment turning FAILED does not release ingredients.
Return URL never changes the status (BR-11).
Past expiresAt the Payment is still PENDING until QueryDR concludes.
QueryDR 00/01 or no verified answer keeps PENDING until
expiresAt + 15 min (grace), then FAILED "EXPIRED" (D6).
Closed only when a call arrives (POST /payments, cancel, sync);
no background job. 04/05/06/07/09 and MISMATCH never auto-close.
MISMATCH is a signed 00 response only; any other code with a wrong
or missing merchant or TxnRef is BAD_RESPONSE (502, closed after the grace).
IPN counts as failed when vnp_TransactionStatus = 02,
including a customer Cancel (24) and an OTP-step timeout (15).
QueryDR 91 after expiry, or the grace elapsed without a verdict:
FAILED with gatewayResponseCode = "EXPIRED", warning
PAYMENT_EXPIRED_UNCONFIRMED. EXPIRED is not a PaymentStatus value.
Money arriving after a final state: IPN 02 + warning
PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED; Order and stock unchanged.
Order.status follows the Payment: SUCCESS -> PAID,
FAILED -> PAYMENT_FAILED. A retry creates a new Payment PENDING.
POST /orders creates order
IPN / QueryDR confirms payment (Payment SUCCESS)
IPN / QueryDR confirms failure (Payment FAILED)
retry payment (new Payment PENDING, same Order)
Customer cancellation [FR-25 Must]
Customer cancellation [FR-25 Must]
Barista
Barista
Barista
POST /payments signs URL (at most one per Order, BR-10)
IPN or QueryDR 00/00 (verified)
IPN or QueryDR final failure
